decision_reason: The predecessor PIN reports one house on the combined lot, while two separate completed permits and two successor assessor PINs identify the two houses built at 4834 and 4830 N Leavitt.
The completed permit locates the separately assessed house at 4834 N Leavitt; physical fields come from the successor assessor row.
The completed permit locates the separately assessed house at 4830 N Leavitt; physical fields come from the successor assessor row.
The two assessor PINs describe one house at 2225 W Cullom. The later PIN reports the permit-supported 2015 construction year and supersedes the older report.
One completed single-family permit locates the successor assessor observation at 2225 W Cullom.
The completed permit confirms one four-unit building at 15 N Bishop; the 2026 whole-building assessor row supplies the physical fields.

The assessor's six units and one square foot are malformed. The completed permit identifies one 32-unit condominium building; comparable whole-building square footage is unavailable, so the project enters DUPAC but not FAR.

Eight tieback rows repeat one building and one PIN-level site area. Count the 16,351-square-foot residence and the 143,808-square-foot site once rather than summing the repeated land field eight times.

The assessor assigns a 2,472-square-foot house to a 176-square-foot parcel sliver. No permit or parcel lineage identifies the complete legal site, so a defensible density denominator cannot be recovered.
The residential PIN is one component of the two-parcel 1218-20 S Washtenaw project retained in the commercial ledger. Keeping both source records would count the same five-unit building twice.
